messages:
diego-sales: Heads-up: AureliaNova POC kicked off. They report intermittent 503s during load tests and their security team emailed the SSQ. Need a triage plan, pricing for a short reserve, and a comms line for their SREs by EOD.

lena-se: Can you drop a sample error log or curl output? 503 could be upstream or model OOM.

diego-sales: From their dev: ```
POST /v1/chat HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk_test_abc
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model":"redwood-chat-force",
  "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"generate summary"}]
}
--- response ---
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
X-Req-ID: rwd-req-9a7b
X-Upstream-Err: no_healthy_upstream
```

priya-eng: That upstream header looks like our routing pool was drained. Are they spiking a single shard? Also any 429s?

zack-ml: We saw a mix: short 429 bursts when they parallelized clients + 503s when the fallback policy tried to spin up cold instances. Their warmup script does 150 concurrent connections for ~90s.

security-bot: New SSQ received: https://internal.redwood.ai/ssq/aurelianova (automated). Assigned to security team.

diego-sales: They also want an interim SLA note and a price delta for a 1-week reserved warmup window vs pay-as-you-go burst.

lena-se: Immediate mitigations: 1) Ask them to reduce client concurrency to <=50 during warmup and add randomized jitter. 2) Enable soft-rate-limiter on proxy to smooth burst. 3) Route their traffic to a Verified smaller model variant for warmup to avoid cold starts.

infra-sre: oncall-bot: creating incident INC-2026-9999 for aurelia-poc routing pressure. I'll check pool health.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-9999 created and assigned to infra-sre.

priya-eng: Quick config change we can do: set their tenant throttles to allow short bursts (burst window 60s) and pre-provision 2 extra workers in us-east-1. Need infra sign-off for cross-tenant capacity.

infra-sre: We have capacity in us-east-1 but need manual approval for tenant burst. Approving now; will add workers and update routing in ~18 minutes.

diego-sales: timeline is tight: their exec demo at 1600 local. Can we commit to under 30 minutes for traffic flip?

infra-sre: Will do. Triggering routing change at 2065432200.

zack-ml: For pricing: rough numbers — 1-week reserve (small GPU pool) ~ $1,800, on-demand bursts ~ $2,200 depending on token/seq. If they need medium GPU for throughput it's +40%. I'll put numbers in a tiny spreadsheet.

lena-se: Also recommend enabling KV-prefix caching for their repetitive prompt templates — reduces tokens and reduces load. That takes ~2-4 hours to validate.

diego-sales: Who owns SSQ answers and DPA? They asked for KMS usage and retention details.

security-bot: Routing SSQ to security-team and compliance. @lena-se please collaborate on KMS/retention sections. Legal will handle DPA template.

lena-se: I'll take the KMS + encryption answers. Diego, send me the fields they flagged as high-priority.

diego-sales: Sent the list to @lena-se. Also CC'ing legal for DPA.

priya-eng: After routing flip we'll monitor 1) 5xx rate 2) token/sec 3) latency p95. If 503s persist we'll fall back to smaller verified variant and throttle user concurrency.

infra-sre: Routing flip completed at 2065432200. Monitoring dashboards show 5xx down 78% and 429 spikes reduced. Keeping the extra workers for 2 hours.

diego-sales: AureliaNova reports the demo went fine and demo SRE said errors are much lower. They want a written summary + cost options.

zack-ml: Sent cost summary to Diego and legal: 1-week reserve $1,800 (small pool), on-demand estimated $2,200, medium pool +40% premium. Attached a short calc table.

lena-se: I'll upload SSQ answers by EOD and attach KMS screenshots.

diego-sales: Great work team. I'll send customers the recs (reduce concurrency, add jitter/backoff, use smaller variant for warmup) and the pricing sheet. Closing this thread but will follow-up on SSQ completion. :white_check_mark:
